name: What are the benefits of adding trim and molding to a home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding trim and molding to a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding trim and molding enhances a home's aesthetic appeal by providing architectural detail, defining spaces, and adding visual interest. It can elevate a room from plain to polished, making it feel more custom and luxurious. Beyond aesthetics, molding can protect walls from wear and tear, especially baseboards. Properly chosen and installed trim also contributes to increased property value and creates a more cohesive design throughout the interior. It’s a cost-effective way to achieve a significant visual upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim and molding enhance aesthetic appeal, add architectural detail, protect walls, and can increase property value, providing a custom and polished look to your home.
